title: Cardinality of a Hamming sphere
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite alphabet and fix a word $u \in \alpha^n$ of length $n$, where the Hamming distance $d(x,y)$ between two words counts the coordinates in which they differ. For every radius $k \in \bbn$, the Hamming sphere $S_k(u) = \{v \in \alpha^n : d(u,v) = k\}$ of words at Hamming distance exactly $k$ from $u$ has cardinality
\[
  \abs{S_k(u)} = \binom{n}{k}\,(\abs{\alpha}-1)^k.
\]
